# Vocabulary: maturity

Adoption maturity of a mechanic across shipped games.

| id | label | definition |
|---|---|---|
| `classic` | Classic | Standard across a genre for 20+ years; players expect it. |
| `established` | Established | Widely shipped in multiple successful games; conventions exist. |
| `emerging` | Emerging | Shipped in a few games within the last 10 years; conventions unsettled. |
| `experimental` | Experimental | Research prototypes or one-off shipped attempts. |
